card.name: Period ending an author bio sentence
card.fires_on: The period closing the first sentence of a short person biography, such as an author or speaker blurb giving a job title and institution. The next sentence usually starts with He or Her.

modes.label: Bio sentence-final period
modes.description: The full stop after a sentence giving a person's title, employer or location, just before the next bio sentence.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words that begin a next biographical sentence, such as past roles or affiliations, though the listed tokens are mixed.
card.plain: It fires at the end of the first sentence of a short professional bio, where a sentence about the person's career or work usually comes next.
